crossRefs.note: that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?
The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.
The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.
Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.
for there will be no reward to the evil man. The lamp of the wicked will be snuffed out.
Behold, all you who kindle a fire, who adorn yourselves with torches around yourselves, walk in the flame of your fire…

translations.web: “Yes, the light of the wicked will be put out. The spark of his fire won’t shine.
translations.bsb: Indeed, the lamp of the wicked is extinguished; the flame of his fire does not glow.
translations.kjv: Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, and the spark of his fire shall not shine.
translations.asv: Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, And the spark of his fire shall not shine.
